A decade has passed since New Ehrengard braved the Crusade. Yet Silence still spreads and Purgatories become a common sight in every kingdom. As faith falters, the Celestial Church sends Inquisitors across Sonnan to reclaim control over kings and commoners. One such Inquisitor arrives in Gravina, tasked with restoring faith by force. 

Wield the full powers of the Celestial Church in both Campaign and Skirmish, with this Songs of Silence expansion!
